definition: the two safety levels below zero and what shuts down at each

settled:
Minus one is sympathetic dominance. Fight, flight, freeze and fawn, and I cannot tell them apart while it is happening because my metacognition has collapsed. Afterwards I can, by which one actually played out.

Minus two is the parasympathetic flop, playing dead. What marks it off is hopelessness. Whatever in me hosts a longing of any kind goes flat there.

Minus two is a full autonomic disable. Arousal shuts down along with hunger, thirst and the ability for my heart rate to go up.

By the time I am anywhere near that line I have lost the ability to initiate. So any safeguard whose last step is me raising something has a step in it I cannot perform at exactly the moment it is wanted. The guard has to be outside me and started from outside, and my widget has to report without either of us doing anything.
